in_sanskrit.name: दिवा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The feminine form of the word 'diva' meaning goddess or light. In Hinduism, there are several goddesses associated with the concept of light, such as Saraswati (goddess of knowledge), Lakshmi (goddess of wealth), and Sita (goddess of virtue and morality).

in_hindi.name: दिवांगी
in_hindi.meaning: Goddess of the body, Light of the body
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Divangi' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'diva' (goddess, light) and 'angi' (body). It can be interpreted as 'goddess of the body' or 'light of the body'.

in_tamil.name: திவாங்கி

in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of 'Divangi' is 'திவாங்கி' which also means 'goddess of the body' or 'light of the body'.

in_telugu.name: దివాఙ్గీ

in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of 'Divangi' is 'దివాఙ్గీ' which also means 'goddess of the body' or 'light of the body'.

in_marathi.name: Divangi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divangi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divangi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'diva' (divine) and 'gani' (knowledge). This name symbolizes the divine knowledge bestowed upon a child.
